assumptions_challenged: That a characterized MCB/WCB for SGL‑001 has been produced and documented.
That intact‑EV assays for SGL‑001 have been validated to show LLOQ, specificity, precision, and accuracy.
That a stability‑indicating potency assay linked and correlated to an in vivo PD endpoint for SGL‑001 has been developed and executed.
That comparability across ≥3 GMP‑like SGL‑001 batches (release specifications, stability, potency) has been performed and reported.
That formulation/device compatibility demonstrating intact‑EV recovery ex vivo and appropriate in vivo controls for SGL‑001 has been demonstrated.
falsification_conditions: Provide MCB/WCB documentation (origin, banking records, QC characterization) linked to SGL‑001.
Provide full analytical validation reports for intact‑EV assays used for SGL‑001 demonstrating LLOQ, specificity, precision, accuracy, and method SOPs.
Provide orthogonal QC panel SOPs and raw data (particle counts, protein/lipid markers, and separation from non‑vesicular particles) for SGL‑001.
Provide a validated, stability‑indicating potency assay report for SGL‑001 that is mechanistically linked and correlated to a defined in vivo PD endpoint (with statistical correlation results).
Provide comparability reports across ≥3 GMP‑like manufacturing runs for SGL‑001 including release specifications, stability data, potency results, and demonstrated lot‑to‑lot reproducibility.
Provide formulation/device compatibility studies showing intact‑EV recovery ex vivo and controlled in vivo experiments that isolate intact‑EV signal from free/non‑vesicular components.
strongest_objection: The MISEV2023 guidance is a best-practice consensus document but does not provide any program-specific CMC, analytics, or batch data for SGL-001; therefore the core program claims (that MCB/WCB exist, intact‑EV assays have been validated with LLOQ/specificity/precision, stability‑linked potency correlated to in vivo PD, comparability across ≥3 GMP‑like batches exists, and formulation/device compatibility with intact‑EV recovery has been demonstrated) are unsupported by the supplied evidence set.
